required_gate.note: MCP003 closes on the required Codex Desktop + Codex CLI host gates and the local/raw protocol adapter gates. Codex IDE, other MCP clients and transport-specific official conformance remain future or separately scoped work.

protocol_adapter.reason: The raw ForgeCAD stdio probe covers canonical 2025-11-25, Codex 2025-06-18 compatibility and explicit unsupported-protocol fail-closed behavior; this direct probe used no proxy. The separate Desktop handshake capture used only a transparent pass-through observer and did not rewrite or synthesize messages.

codex_desktop.reason: The captured Codex Desktop initialize request used protocolVersion 2025-06-18 and ForgeCAD returned the same value. The user-provided Desktop read-only transcript and current Codex app receipt completed discovery, connection, capabilities/project/resources/selection/version reads with no ForgeCAD project, Job, model or version write. launchctl CODEX_MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION=2026-07-28 was ignored by Desktop; every captured request still used 2025-06-18, so Desktop forced mismatch is not applicable.

codex_cli.reason: An authenticated real codex exec read-only turn completed capabilities_get and selection_get with no project, Runtime or user-config writes. A separate authenticated run requesting 2026-07-28 returned unsupported-protocol, made no ForgeCAD tool call, produced no side effect and did not silently downgrade.

codex_ide.reason: Codex IDE / VS Code / Cursor / Windsurf is retained as future compatibility, but is not a current P0 product entry point, is not installed for this acceptance, and is not an MCP003 or MCP004 release blocker. The separate Computer Use attempt was blocked before initialize and remains accurately recorded as an automation-surface result.

other_mcp_clients.reason: Future compatibility target; no current P0 acceptance.

official_conformance.reason: The available official runner is documented for Streamable HTTP, while MCP003 product scope is local stdio. No HTTP proxy was introduced or counted as stdio evidence. This remains future transport-specific validation, not a current P0 host blocker.

computer_use_host_probe.evidence: At the 2026-08-08 acceptance attempt, a read-only Computer Use state request for com.openai.codex was denied by the host safety boundary. App discovery showed ChatGPT/com.openai.codex running, but did not grant a controllable UI. The Codex in-app Browser connected successfully and both current-tab and user-tab listings were empty. No automated UI click, typing, upload, configuration change, or host-side write action was performed.
computer_use_host_probe.reason: This is an automation-surface result only. It does not override the separately captured Desktop handshake/read-only evidence and does not create an IDE P0 blocker.

codex_app_server_diagnostic.evidence: Temporary CODEX_HOME, no model turn, no user config mutation: Codex Desktop/0.147.0-alpha.6.5 app-server started an ephemeral read-only thread, emitted startup ready after the explicit compatibility implementation, listed 14 tools plus one resource, and called selection_get with structuredContent available=false. This supports the host diagnosis but is not the sole Desktop acceptance evidence.
